newsitem.title: JAPAN: One person dies as Typhoon Opal sweeps across Japan.
newsitem.headline: One person dies as Typhoon Opal sweeps across Japan.

text.p: Typhoon Opal stormed through central Japan on Friday, killing one person and disrupting air, rail and road traffic.
Opal, classified by Japan's Meteorological Agency as a medium-strength typhoon, was packing maximum winds of 108 kph (68 mph).
Police said a 60-year-old fisherman drowned after falling into waters while tying his boat to a wharf.
Moving north-northeast at a speed of 50 kph (31 mph), the typhoon was expected to veer northeast and move away from the Japanese archipelago later on Friday, the agency said.
The typhoon forced the cancellation of more than 100 domestic flights, affecting about 5,000 passengers.
Thousands of schools were also forced to close because of the typhoon.
